first.rationale: Prioritize a sustainable response to the concurrent onboarding-completion and activation declines: prior evidence indicates onboarding shortening improved completion, time-to-value, and early adoption, while signup simplification durably lifted first-week SMB activation. Verify the onboarding result and the pricing-retention tradeoff before committing, since competitor pricing creates pressure to discount but promotional pricing previously harmed 30-day retention.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment simplifying onboarding. This directly addresses the 4% decline in onboarding completion and the 6% activation decline, with verified prior evidence of +13% completion, 2.1 fewer days to value, and +3% 30-day retention. The separate durable SMB activation lift from signup simplification reinforces the mechanism. Do not use promotional pricing: despite qualified-revenue gains, its -12% 30-day retention result conflicts with the sustainable long-term qualified-revenue objective.
